3219.title: Pi reasoning can show a false zero-duration title
3219.rootCauseOneLine: Batched events share one persistence timestamp, and reasoning projection always formats the resulting zero delta as a duration.
3219.proposedFix: Render a duration only when completion is later than start; keep truthful positive durations unchanged.
3219.caveats: The deterministic projection defect and batch timestamp path were verified twice; private-thread frequency and provider-side elapsed time were not measured.
